$comment: Informational schema — canonical source is packages/shared/src/interfaces.ts (EventEnvelope, EventTransport, EventData). This file exists only to aid IDE tooling and documentation. Do not use as validation authority.
title: EventEnvelope
description: CloudEvents-inspired envelope for NATS JetStream messaging. Producers: api-gateway, channel-service, registry-service, agent-admin-service, ai-agent-gateway. IDs are crypto.randomUUID() (UUID v4). Type format for messaging: io.yoizen.messaging.<channel>.<provider>.<kind>.v1. correlation_id defaults to envelope id when not propagated.

source.description: URI of the service that produced the event

type.description: Reverse-domain event type. Messaging format: io.yoizen.messaging.<channel>.<provider>.<kind>.v1. Other producers use their own domain token.

causation_id.description: ID of the event that caused this one. null for root events.

correlation_id.description: End-to-end business flow ID. Propagated unchanged via deriveEnvelope. Defaults to the envelope's own id when not explicitly passed (buildEventEnvelope / createChannelEnvelope).

producer.description: Service that published the event. Real producers: api-gateway, channel-service, registry-service, agent-admin-service, ai-agent-gateway.

accountid.description: Provider account ID within the tenant. Absent in WebhookIngressEnvelope (unknown before signature verification).

idempotencykey.description: Deterministic dedupe key: sha256(canonicalJson(payload)). Mapped to NATS Nats-Msg-Id header.

transport.description: How the event arrived. Canonical type: EventTransport in packages/shared/src/interfaces.ts.

depth.description: Causal chain depth for anti-loop enforcement (see MAX_DEPTH_BY_CATEGORY in envelope.utils.ts)

data.description: Payload metadata and content. Canonical type: EventData in packages/shared/src/interfaces.ts.

payload_inline.description: true when the payload is embedded; false for claim-check (large payload)

payload_ref.description: Object Store URI when payload_inline=false. Format: nats://objstore/PAYLOAD-<tenant>/<envelope.id>-payload

payload_checksum.description: sha256 of canonicalJson(payload) bytes. Used by claim-check consumer for integrity verification.

payload.description: Actual payload when payload_inline=true. null when claim-check.

callback_url.description: Optional pipeline extension: URL to POST completion results to

adapter_id.description: Optional pipeline extension: adapter ID for webhook delivery auth

enrich_adapter.description: Optional pipeline extension: adapter ref for pre-handler enrichment

forward_adapter.description: Optional pipeline extension: adapter ref for post-handler forwarding
